name: Hayat Tarzı Dergisi
description: Turkey's premier lifestyle magazine, celebrating the best in Turkish culture and living.
story: Hayat Tarzı Dergisi seeks to connect with a passionate and driven audience. Motorsport embodies the pursuit of excellence and the thrill of competition, values that align perfectly with our brand. We aim to increase brand awareness among a younger demographic and showcase the vibrant lifestyle associated with motorsports.
